address: 33 King Street, Covent Garden, London, WC2E 8JD, United Kingdom
bio: There's a comforting, bygone-era charm to Clos Maggiore, one of London's most distinctive and romantic restaurants that's bright and airy in summer and cosy in winter. The enchanting conservatory with its retractable roof is the prime place to sit, but love is in the air throughout thanks to the soft lighting and abundant indoor flora. Seasonal, French-inspired dishes are joined by a wine list of considerable depth. The lunchtime and pre/post-theatre menus are great value and are a hit with one and all....
